title: Research
text: My research spans public policy, nonprofit management, political science, and international relations. I study human rights and international nonprofit management and I focus on authoritarian regulation of civil society and international NGO responses to administrative crackdown. I also research causal inference methods, particularly using panel data.

title: Theo Konc’s academic website
text:
I’m an assistant professor at the Wageningen University in the Netherlands and guest Researcher at the Lab “Societal Transition and Well-Being and Development” at the Potsdam Institute For Climamate Impact Research in Germany. Prior to coming to the Netherlands, I was Postdoctoral Researcher at Technical University of Berlin. I received a PhD in Economics Cum Laude from the Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona (UAB) in 2021.
I study WHATEVER, and I got in 2021 an Honorable mention as part of Emerging Scholar Dissertation Award from the European Association of Environmental and Resource Economists (EAERE). I do research in WHATEVER.
I teach courses on WHATEVER.
